snippet.title: Chimera Circuit -- Wishlist on Steam Now Trailer

Breed over 1,000,000 hybrid chimeras from over 100 species, train their stats, and outmaneuver rivals in tactical grid-based races. With deep genetics, betting, and rogue-like progression Chimera Circuit blends strategy and speed.
